Explain in 3 short sentences why running a 26B mixture-of-experts model on a Raspberry Pi is hard, then say 'שלום' in Hebrew.<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
<|channel>thought
<channel|>A 26B parameter model requires massive amounts of VRAM that far exceed the Raspberry Pi's limited memory capacity. The model's architecture is too computationally intensive for the Pi's low-power processor to handle efficiently. Additionally, the slow data transfer speeds of the Pi's hardware would result in extremely sluggish performance.

שלום [end of text]
